scope: Forge 47.4.10 development client with same-ID fixture items, installed Grilling, Cookery, ImmersiveEating, GeckoLib, Embeddium and Mekalus. Final captures use a fully hidden window and disabled shaders. Nine requested items tested with both slim and Steve arms; after the final lower-grip and opaque-neck changes, all nine were checked again with slim arms and the three affected items with Steve arms, including authored stow to empty hand. Both runs include base interaction and rapid selection checks. All 24 hand masks and native skin/sleeve meshes validated for both hand sizes and dominant hands. All 48 Blockbench projects exported from 1.6.2 runtime transforms, including restored 5.2-second inspection timing (water 3.8 seconds), C2 interpolation for seven families, observed world-camera rocking, damped XO lean, constant lower-corner support with a rigid bottle-local main-hand transform through inspection return, vertical can shaking, corrected outward shell surfaces, ballistic water flight and beer cap bite/spit; runtime polygon clipping is not reproduced in Blockbench. Full modpack not tested.
